Un jeu de réflexes au centre de tri : en: A reflex game at the sorting centre: send each parcel on the belt to the bin of its colour with ← ↓ →, before it crosses the line. The bins shuffle every 15 parcels, bombs must go through unsorted, the combo multiplies points up to ×5 and the belt speeds up. Three mistakes and the day is over. Full screen button and a game that fits the screen, a bigger belt and parcels, fragile and double parcels, and bombs no longer block the game: they rush to the hole, and ↑ drops them in right away. The rule changes on the way: by colour, by shape or by weight, announced by the boss.
